hooks.command: input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.pattern // empty'); if echo "$path" | grep -q '\.env'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Reading .env files is not allowed"}'; fi
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; npx prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
